values.note: Electric sites (20/30/50-amp) $35 a night for non-residents; Charlevoix County residents pay $30. Cancellations need 7 days' notice ($10 cancellation fee).

note: Charlevoix County park on Lake Charlevoix in Eveline Township between Boyne City and Ironton: 240 forested acres with 4 miles of hiking trails. The beach has about 500 ft of Lake Charlevoix waterfront, half a swim area (no lifeguards) and half a rustic dog-friendly area with boat anchoring; playgrounds, grilling stations, a rental hall, a 1940s log cabin and two pavilions. --Claude
